teacher.input: Acting hand, legal actions and a decision-time public-information snapshot.
teacher.target: Score the actual execution of each fixed runtime proposal. Equivalent no-op executions have zero advantage.
teacher.sampling: At most four public wall-count stages per game. Entirely equivalent execution groups do not consume a sample slot.

distillation.loss: Grouped cross entropy over equivalent best executions. Critic excludes teacher targets.
distillation.trainable: Shared trunk and actor head, including the four public hasWon input columns.

ppo.opponents: Three formal AI8 players with one rotating learner seat.
ppo.valueLoss: Huber beta=1 on actual complete-hand returns.

training.preparation: Existing exchange-three and missing-suit policies execute before the public decisions used for training.

deployment.proposal: One masked neural proposal, including the fixed anchor as no-op, followed by the same bounded runtime search used during training.

reference.used: Clipped PPO formula, gamma=1 and per-seat returns. Rules, runtime, features, teacher, search and MLP are project implementations.
